name: Clicker Kingdom
how: Every click adds gold to one shared kingdom. Spend it on farms, windmills and mines that keep earning, and on upgrades that make every click worth more.
controls: Click or tap the kingdom, then tap the shop to build
uses: The kingdom is remembered by the players who built it, and its farms and mines keep earning while everyone is away.
The players who have given the kingdom the most gold.
The host's browser counts every click and checks every purchase; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bot helpers click and buy until enough people join.
ideas: Add a boss everyone clicks down together
Add a reset that gives a permanent bonus
